additional_info.subject: RE: ID0392549-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001199] Error on outlet 2 CRM:01811000493
additional_info.body:
Hello Marnic,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding the ongoing issue about  the HPC cable, I would like to suggest the possibility of performing an onsite verification before proceeding with the cable replacement. Although the issue is believed to stem from the microprocessor inside the cable, as per the experts analysis, there remains a chance that the problem could be related to a false contact in the CAN bus line. In this case, performing an additional onsite check may save both time and money, avoiding the need for a full cable replacement.
The primary areas to verify during the onsite inspection include:
Microcontroller CAN communication line
: Confirm whether the line has stopped or lost communication due to a hardware or firmware error.
XD12 loose wiring
: While unlikely, kindly inspect the XD12 connections for any potential loose wiring.
KF11 CAN communication error
: Check if there are any issues related to the CAN communication at the KF11, which could be affecting the information transfer.
Signal Line Check
: For further troubleshooting, verify the CAN bus line between XD101 and KF11. Both the orange and white cables should measure approximately 60 ohms. Any deviation could indicate a potential issue.
2. The following pins and connectors should be checked:
F01-XD34 pins 13-15-25-26-27-28
F01-XD37 pins 1-2-3-5-6-7-10-11-12-13-14-15-16-18
If no issues are found during the onsite inspection and the charger still displays an error related to the cable, then proceed with the cable replacement.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
